structured_output.summary: I changed `normalize` in src/coupon.mjs to `(value) => value.toUpperCase()`, so lowercase coupon codes now come back in uppercase. The export name and signature are the same, and I didn't touch the existing test in test/coupon.test.mjs. I haven't run the tests because no shell was available. The change does what that test checks: normalize('save') returns 'SAVE'. Passing a value that isn't a string now throws an error; before, it was returned unchanged.
